SELECT
  T2.team_short_name
FROM Team_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Team AS T2
  ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE
  T1.date LIKE '2009%'
  AND T1.buildUpPlaySpeed > T1.defencePressure
  AND T1.chanceCreationPassing > T1.defencePressure
  AND T1.chanceCreationPassingClass = T1.chanceCreationShootingClass
  AND T1.buildUpPlayDribbling > T1.defencePressure
  AND T1.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = T1.chanceCreationShootingClass

    SELECT
      team_api_id
    FROM Team
    WHERE
      team_short_name = 'GEN'
  )
GROUP BY
  T2.team_short_name
HAVING
  COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT
      MAX(count)
    FROM (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS count
      FROM Team_Attributes
      WHERE
        date LIKE '2009%'
        AND season = '2009/2010'
    ) AS counts
  )
LIMIT 1
